input.request: Build Skill Credential, an issuer-controlled credential-verification page. Token name: Skill Credential. Token symbol: SKIL. The fixed total supply is 1,000,000,000 tokens with 18 decimals (1,000,000,000 * 10^18 base units), minted once to the deployer. SkillCredential lets an issuer grant a recipient a credential bound to a bytes32 evidence hash and uint256 expiry, revoke a credential it issued, and lets anyone verify current status. Deploy on Sepolia and publish a page to issue, revoke and verify credentials.
input.context: Sepolia only (chainId 11155111); GitHub and IPFS are approved. Include Foundry tests and an independent adversarial review. Constructors use only address, uint256, bool or bytes32 arguments; the launch token constructor is zero-argument. foundry.toml must set bytecode_hash = "none". No proxy, delegatecall or selfdestruct. Issuers pay to create or revoke their own records; verifiers read status and expiry requires no scheduled transaction. Treat the evidence hash as public metadata, not private data.

draft.objective: Build and review SKIL and SkillCredential, deploy them on Sepolia, then publish the live credential-verification website.

steps.objective: Implement fixed-supply SKIL and issuer-scoped credential records.
Test issuer scope, recipient identity, evidence hashes, expiry and revocation.
Independently adversarially review issuer authorization and status logic.
Build the live issuer, revocation and public verification page.
